Authenticate using the API key ID and the secret key
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/oauth/token

Authenticate using the API key ID and the secret key. The response returns a token that must be used in subsequent requests.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
key_id
string
REQUIRED

The API key ID.

key_secret
string
REQUIRED

The secret key. This must be SHA256 for secret key and timestamp. For example, SHA256("secret key:timestamp").

timestamp
integer

The time stamp in epoch seconds. Requests sent after 15 mins are invalid.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation. The response contains the token and the token type. The token is valid for 3600 seconds.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
token
string
REQUIRED

Token

token_type
string
REQUIRED

Token Type

Default value: Bearer
expires_in
integer
REQUIRED

The expiry time in seconds.

Default value: 3600
